dedup.scope: Public metadata index of 14878 items and the 3202-row retired-claim record and the 162-row current worklist were searched with the object names and terms Askey-Wilson, q-Onsager, tridiagonal, Terwilliger, commutator, free product of cyclic groups and q^6; only problem_id 2574 and the published task A-2574-psl2-faithfulness (problem_id 900000002) come from this source, and neither is this claim. scouting/algebra/SELECTION.md and the source reading records for this block were read, and the nearest counted statements were compared one by one. Focused comparison of the actual near neighbours, not a claim of universal proof-equivalence search.

compared.statement: The center of the universal Askey-Wilson algebra over a field is freely spanned by monomials in its Casimir and three specified central generators when the nonzero deformation parameter is not a root of unity.
compared.difference: A basis statement about the center of Delta; it never mentions the q-Onsager algebra O or the elements xi_1, xi_2 and does not decide when they commute.

compared.statement: Faithfulness of the modular-group action on the universal Askey-Wilson algebra (source label thm:faith).
compared.difference: Same paper, different algebra and different conclusion; the counted statement here lives in the q-Onsager algebra and is proved in Section 9, outside that task's retained proof core.

compared.statement: The explicit universal Askey-Wilson homomorphism into U_q(sl_2) tensor a three-variable Laurent polynomial algebra is injective for nonzero q with q^4 not 1.
compared.difference: Another paper and another algebra homomorphism; no q-Onsager commutativity statement.

compared.statement: Unitary decomposition of a specified coproduct representation of U_q(su(1,1)).
compared.difference: Unrelated representation-theoretic claim about a different algebra.

compared.statement: Spectral Moore upper bound for connected bipartite regular graphs with an admissible tridiagonal spectral parameter.
compared.difference: The word tridiagonal is the only overlap; no algebra, no q-Onsager elements.

dedup.research_line_basis: Only two counted items exist for this source in the public index and worklist; both were read and compared. No in-preparation card from this source exists.
